name: Splatter Wipe
description: Splats of paint land one after another, each popping in with a spiky outline, flung droplets and a few drips running down, revealing the second clip until they cover the frame. Drive `progress` from 0 to 1.

inputs.name: second
inputs.description: Incoming clip (same size as the first)

params.name: splats
params.description: Number of splats across the frame

params.name: spikiness
params.description: How long the spikes around each splat are

params.name: droplets
params.description: How many droplets are flung around each splat

params.name: drips
params.description: How far the paint drips run down

params.name: rim
params.description: How dark and glossy the rim of the splats is
